verdict.rationale: Airbyte's docs say MCP-capable agents (Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, Codex) can connect to user data through Airbyte Agents, and a probe confirms an official MCP server page. Related docs describe agents querying, searching, and acting on data in real time. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the MCP server's tools, auth, and setup steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect MCP-capable agents like Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, and Codex to your data through Airbyte Agents.
